short: Self-healing polymer coatings of polyurea-urethane/epoxy ble
title: Self-healing polymer coatings of polyurea-urethane/epoxy blends with reversible and dynamic bonds

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Protective coatings need to close and repair a scratch by themselves and keep their barrier function, without giving up hardness or adhesion. Combining dynamic disulfide bonds in the polymer backbone with reversible Diels-Alder crosslinks that drive nanoscale epoxy phase separation should give a coating that both closes and welds a crack.
states.detail: Absorbed: j1 (HYP/need), j2 (HYP/hypothesis), j3 (DES/base_system), j4 (DES/modification), j5 (DES/variable_sweep), j6 (PRC/synthesis), j7 (PRC/deposition), j21 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Polyurethanes carrying disulfide groups in the main chain self-heal by disulfide exchange together with hydrogen bonding among urea groups; The furan-maleimide Diels-Alder reaction runs forward near 60 C and backward near 130 C

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Diels-Alder adducts form between the furan groups on the FTPU chain ends and on the epoxy oligomers and the BMI maleimides, giving reversible crosslinks and reversible interfacial bonds. Crosslinking separates the epoxy into domains below 100 nm dispersed in the FTPU matrix, denser at 5:5 and largely suppressed when the BMI is halved.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The blends are about twice as strong as the pristine FTPU (14-15 against 7.8 MPa) but far less extensible, and their room-temperature storage modulus is lower. The blends add a new relaxation between about 45 and 80 C that the pristine FTPU does not have, rising with epoxy and BMI content.
states.detail: Absorbed: j10 (PRP/value), j11 (PRP/value), j12 (PRP/behavior_class), j14 (MEC/pathway), j13 (PRP/value). Premises: Healing efficiency is defined from the healed and original tensile strength and elongation at break

states.title: Performance state
states.head: After a 10 min press at 130 C the scratched blend coatings keep red dye off the wood and saline off the tinplate for 7 days, where the damaged ones do not

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A polyurea-urethane/epoxy blend whose reversible Diels-Alder network both creates nanoscale domains and releases them on heating gives a shape-memory-assisted, self-healing protective coating

nodes.solves: The blends are shape-memory materials: fixation 90-91% and recovery 99%, but fixation collapses to 24% when the BMI is halved
